question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG("loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV("loss_rate_%") as stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) as avg_loss_rate,
    (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) as stddev_loss_rate,
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) as lower_bound,
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) as upper_bound,
    COUNT(*) as total_items,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) - (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) THEN 1 END) as below_std,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) + (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) THEN 1 END) as above_std,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) - (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) AND "loss_rate_%" <= (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) + (SELECT stddev_loss_rate FROM stats) THEN 1 END) as within_std
FROM veg_loss_rate_df
